journey.name: wear send deeplink bolt11
journey.description:
A `lightning:` link to a BOLT11 invoice opens the review with the amount; holding the pay button fills the ring around the bezel and pays; the check shows "Sent" and the flow closes by itself after about 2 s. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats (run receive-paid.xml first), see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, with the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. README › Holding to pay has the hold gesture.

actions.action: Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 1000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Hold "WatchSendHold" for 2 s as in README › Holding to pay
Wait up to 15 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed
Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
